blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transportation Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez on Tuesday said the government is continuing efforts to ease the impact of rising fuel prices amid woes in the transportation sector. READ: OIL PRICE WATCH as of Sept. 22, 2026 Lopez said that the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board’s hearing on the pending fare hike petitions is ongoing with concerned agencies and transport groups. “Pagdating po sa ating fare hike po, ito po ‘yung sinasabi ko parati na at this point in time po, pinipiga pa rin natin ang gobyerno,” he said.
